corpus_assessment.inclusion_rationale: The adopted JURI report contains substantive AI and robotics governance proposals on ethics, liability, research, sectoral regulation and a European robotics and AI agency, preceding Parliament's distinct resolution of 16 February 2017.
corpus_assessment.researcher_notes: Publication means official parliamentary tabling for plenary on 27 January 2017, not an established first server-upload timestamp. Committee adoption was 12 January 2017. The report's six embedded committee opinions remain components of this report. The separate resolution's CELEX/OJ identifiers do not identify this report. Document type, sectors, relevance and policy stage are editorial classifications; rapporteur credits remain distinct from institutional authorship.
